title: Chess Blocks
description: This Project adds Chess Blocks To your Game (creative)
body:
# Chess Blocks

I hope you can play minecraft / chess on my first ever mod

(This works clientside Not sure about server side)

1 Add the mod normaly into the mod folder 

2 Go to Creative

3 Play Chess

In this screenshot i was using shaders
